classes.name: regolith
classes.definition: Visible loose or granular surface material.

classes.name: bedrock
classes.definition: Continuous exposed, consolidated substrate with visible rock structure.

classes.name: rock
classes.definition: Discrete positive-relief rock, cobble, or boulder.

classes.name: crater
classes.definition: Geometrically supported negative-relief impact depression and its inner rim.

classes.name: shadow
classes.definition: Cast shadow region, independent of the underlying surface material.
